features.feature: Guarded wrapperless VS Code Codex session adoption
contract: A VS Code SessionStart with no HCOM_PROCESS_ID creates one codex row and a session binding using the supplied transcript/cwd.
A repeated or concurrent SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit for that session returns the same row and never creates a duplicate.
The first ordinary UserPromptSubmit can deliver pending hcom context after adoption.
Wrong originator, missing session, SessionEnd, tool hooks, and stop hooks do not create identities or bypass the gate.
A failed transaction leaves no partially created row or session binding.

Weakening any guard creates spoofing or cross-tool adoption; falling back to passive markers recreates the retired identity-stealing path.
features.validation: Native CLI 8 passed (4 participation cases plus 4 shared fixture checks); original target unit run included native/Codex/start/binding tests.
